gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-kr: Dogica's lowercase climbs nearly to cap height, spaced wide and heavy. Noto Sans KR, a plain sans with generous curve gaps and stubby ascenders, keeps a long block of text going smoothly without tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-lao: Dogica spaces its heavy, tall-standing letters out wide and commands attention. Noto Sans Lao brings an x-height pushed well above the usual, and that lifted, open lowercase is the strongest thing the pair has going.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-lao-loope: Noto Sans Lao Looped sets words as solid blocks, its bowls left unfinished on one side. Dogica above it is the blunt one, heavy and widely tracked, and that gap in temperament is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu has tall-bodied small letters and curves that gape open. Dogica is heavy and wide where that sans is light on its feet, and they feel like a shout and a friendly reply.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Tidy and unfussy, this sans-serif body keeps ascender tops tucked close to the x-height line. Dogica is the one for heavy, wide-spaced statements, and Noto Sans Lisu is the one for quietly carrying the details with its open s curves.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Noto Sans Lydian keeps its capitals barely taller than the lowercase, with openings like a sprung paper clip. Dogica is best at heavy, wide-tracked punch, while this sans-serif is best at friendly, easygoing text.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Dogica is heavy and commanding, with wide tracking. It does the loud work, and Noto Sans Mahajani, a plain sans with tall lowercase and a funnel-wide e, does the careful talking.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Noto Sans Malayalam reads with a dense middle zone and an s that opens up between bends. Dogica is built to hit hard with heavy, wide letters, while this plain sans is built to settle in and stay readable.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-mayan-num: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals reads tall-bodied, with a c that gapes open at any size. Dogica's heavy, wide-spaced weight against that plain sans makes the pair's strongest quality its sharp, confident difference.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-medefaidr: Contemporary and sharp, Dogica lands heavy and widely tracked, with open curve endings. And Noto Sans Medefaidrin, a sans-serif with high-rising lowercase and no ink pooling in its turns, carries a full page of text crisply.
